# bcm_cmpart_softwareimages (Data Source)

Fetches software images from BCM CMPart service. Software images are operating system images used to provision DPU nodes with kernel configuration and modules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "bcm_cmpart_softwareimages" "all" {}

output "all_images" {
  description = "All software images from BCM"
  value       = data.bcm_cmpart_softwareimages.all.images
}

output "image_count" {
  description = "Number of software images"
  value       = length(data.bcm_cmpart_softwareimages.all.images)
}

output "image_names" {
  description = "List of software image names"
  value = [
    for img in data.bcm_cmpart_softwareimages.all.images :
    img.name
  ]
}

output "ubuntu_images" {
  description = "Filter images by name pattern (ubuntu)"
  value = [
    for img in data.bcm_cmpart_softwareimages.all.images :
    img if can(regex("ubuntu", lower(img.name)))
  ]
}

output "images_with_modules" {
  description = "Images that have kernel modules configured"
  value = [
    for img in data.bcm_cmpart_softwareimages.all.images :
    {
      name         = img.name
      module_count = length(img.modules)
      module_names = [for mod in img.modules : mod.name]
    }
    if length(img.modules) > 0
  ]
}

output "sol_enabled_images" {
  description = "Images with Serial Over LAN enabled"
  value = [
    for img in data.bcm_cmpart_softwareimages.all.images :
    {
      name      = img.name
      sol_port  = img.sol_port
      sol_speed = img.sol_speed
    }
    if img.enable_sol
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block, Optional) Optional filters to narrow down the list of software images. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for this data source
- `images` (Attributes List) List of software images retrieved from BCM (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Optional:

- `category` (String) Exact match for image category (child_type).
- `name_pattern` (String) Case-insensitive substring match for image name.


<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `base_type` (String) Base operating system type (e.g., Linux)
- `bootfs_part` (String) Boot filesystem partition
- `child_type` (String) OS distribution type (e.g., Ubuntu)
- `creation_time` (Number) Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when image was created
- `enable_sol` (Boolean) Serial Over LAN enabled flag
- `file_operation_in_progress` (Boolean) File operation currently executing on image
- `fs_part` (String) Root filesystem partition
- `id` (String) Software image identifier (same as uuid)
- `kernel_output_console` (String) Kernel output console configuration
- `kernel_parameters` (String) Kernel boot parameters
- `kernel_version` (String) Linux kernel version (e.g., 5.15.0-58-generic)
- `modified` (Boolean) Image has been modified from original
- `modules` (Attributes List) Kernel modules configured for this image (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images--modules))
- `name` (String) Software image name
- `notes` (String) Free-form notes about the image
- `original_image` (String) Name of original base image
- `parent_software_image` (String) Name of parent image (for derived images)
- `parent_uuid` (String) UUID of parent image
- `path` (String) File system path to image on BCM server
- `revision` (String) Image revision string
- `revision_id` (Number) Numeric revision identifier
- `sol_flow_control` (Boolean) SOL hardware flow control enabled
- `sol_port` (String) SOL serial port (e.g., ttyS0)
- `sol_speed` (String) SOL baud rate (e.g., 115200)
- `to_be_removed` (Boolean) Image scheduled for deletion
- `uuid` (String) Software image UUID

<a id="nestedatt--images--modules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images.modules`

Read-Only:

- `base_type` (String) Module category
- `child_type` (String) Module subcategory
- `modified` (Boolean) Module configuration has been modified
- `name` (String) Module name (e.g., nvidia-drm)
- `parameters` (String) Module load parameters
- `revision` (String) Module version
- `to_be_removed` (Boolean) Module scheduled for removal
- `uuid` (String) Module UUID
